_comment: T3434 Rule 24 retirement candidates for python3 -m tools.retire. Port profiles use source/form to enumerate replaced VAs; REPLACE profiles use kind=replace and replacement to enumerate host switch, C units, symbols, call sites, build entries and staged evidence. switch is the A/B selector; hook is the lifted_selectable name; profile is the tools.gate evidence profile.

replacement.remove_after: all listed production C callers have native Rust replacements; a host build with kernel_file.c and xdvdfs.c excluded succeeds; then the full regress loop passes with Rust as default
replacement.call_site_prerequisite: move every listed production C caller to Rust and prove the host builds with kernel_file.c and xdvdfs.c excluded

build_edits.before:
add_executable(test_kernel_file tests/c/test_kernel_file.c)
target_link_libraries(test_kernel_file PRIVATE tsfp_xbox)
set_target_properties(test_kernel_file PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
tsfp_native_fileio_contract(test_kernel_file)
add_test(NAME kernel_file COMMAND test_kernel_file)

add_executable(test_xdvdfs_c tests/c/test_xdvdfs_c.c)
target_link_libraries(test_xdvdfs_c PRIVATE tsfp_xbox)
set_target_properties(test_xdvdfs_c PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
add_test(NAME xdvdfs_c COMMAND test_xdvdfs_c)

# A strong object precedes the oracle archive, so its kernel_file.o is never pulled.
    add_library(tsfp_fileio_selected_kernel OBJECT src/xbox/kernel_file.c)
    target_include_directories(tsfp_fileio_selected_kernel PRIVATE
      $<TARGET_PROPERTY:tsfp_xbox,INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES>)
    target_compile_definitions(tsfp_fileio_selected_kernel PRIVATE
      $<TARGET_PROPERTY:tsfp_xbox,COMPILE_DEFINITIONS> TSFP_FILEIO_SELECTED_KERNEL=1)
    target_sources(tsfp_host PRIVATE $<TARGET_OBJECTS:tsfp_fileio_selected_kernel>)
